sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Safe Corridor is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Oh, there you are! Good timing, I could use your help. My lads tried to "borrow" a few supplies from the Reserve base, but things went to shit. Some serious bandits have dug in there. And I reckon we won't be able to search the place properly until someone gives them a proper scare. I couldn't care less about the whole base, but that underground storage? That's where my interest is. You fancy going over there and lending a hand? And if you can, bring me the keys to the underground section too."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 5 Scavs in the underground storage warehouse on Reserve
- Hand over any 3 found in raid keys for the underground storage warehouse (RB-PSP and RB-PSV)

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.75
- 1,650 Euros
  - 1,733 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,898 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Already picked clean, you say? Fuck's sake!"

In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs in the underground warehouse and the ramps leading down to it on Reserve. The wanted warehouse is located in the northwest and marked with "Д".
